status_note: Verified live this session (2026-06-01): a control-op kill broadcasts the gossip tombstone (GossipDigest state=Leaving), evicting the node from its own mesh in <0.1s; apply_tombstone source=gossip_receive on observers (the T4 Leaving path). Generalized into NodeState in sprint-20.
in_scope: gossip tombstone: leaving=true flavor of GossipDigest for fast eviction
apply_tombstone() shared function: evicts from live_digests, topic_membership, last_seen_ms
broadcast_tombstone() in node-base: enqueues to tombstone outbox + self-applies
run_gossip: tombstone outbox drain + leaving-digest receive handling
resurrection guard: recently_tombstoned set prevents in-flight digest re-insertion
out_of_scope: dedicated tombstone message type (leaving flag on GossipDigest is sufficient)
cross-mesh tombstone relay (backbone naturally propagates via MeshSummary refresh)
graceful self-broadcast on SIGTERM (local node.stopping path; not needed for the proof)
design_constraints: tombstone MUST use the existing gossip subscribe/broadcast — no new transport
eviction MUST happen in run_gossip receive path so all observers evict uniformly
kill path MUST NOT hand-edit remote process maps (rejected design)
cross-mesh eviction routes via backbone: killer evicts locally, gateway drops X from next MeshSummary
supersedes: the rejected sprint-15 attempt that hand-edited live_digests() in kill_one as the delete mechanism

spans_to_emit.description: Emitted by apply_tombstone() on every observer that processes a tombstone — proves eviction went through the gossip receive path. source=local on the killer console (self-injection), source=gossip_receive on all other observers.
